description:
Create clear Do and Don't code comparison images for documentation, articles, and social posts — in seconds.

How It Works:
Paste a good and a bad snippet, pick a language and theme, and export a polished PNG with a Do or Don't badge.

Customize Your Way:
• Syntax highlighting for 19 languages
• 11 syntax themes, dark and light
• Badge position, style, size, and custom label
• Font size from 10 to 24 pt
• Optional title bar for cleaner exports

Export:
• High-resolution 2x PNG
• Side-by-side or stacked layout
• Save to a folder you choose
• Reveal in Finder from the confirmation toast

Built for Mac:
• Full VoiceOver support
• Reduced motion support

Privacy First:
• All processing happens locally on your Mac
• No data collected or sent anywhere
• Works completely offline
promotionalText: Turn two code snippets into a clean Do and Don't comparison image. 19 languages, 11 themes, 2x PNG export.
